The campus budget risk calculation succeeded with a perfect verifier reward, demonstrating a robust implementation of the weighted assessment logic.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and passed the pytest suite in test_output.py without exceptions. While the logic is reusable, the 5m 26s runtime suggests potential overhead in the adhoc hermes gpt-5.5 environment. Future iterations should verify that the weighted-risk assumptions remain valid across varying campus budget scales.
